## File: facebookresearch_maskrcnn-benchmark/maskrcnn_benchmark/config/paths_catalog.py

Prompts

```
['get a dataset catalog entry by name for coco, voc, or cityscapes datasets', 'get a model download URL by name for Caffe2 Detectron or ImageNet pretrained models', 'list all available dataset names and their configuration from the DATASETS catalog dictionary', 'list all available pretrained model names and signatures from the C2_DETECTRON_MODELS catalog', 'review the DatasetCatalog class and its DATASETS dictionary to understand supported dataset paths and splits']
```

Usage

```
{'get_dataset_catalog_entry': 'get a dataset catalog entry by name for coco, voc, or cityscapes datasets', 'get_model_catalog_url': 'get a model download URL by name for Caffe2 Detectron or ImageNet pretrained models', 'list_available_datasets': 'list all available dataset names and their configuration from the DATASETS catalog dictionary', 'list_available_models': 'list all available pretrained model names and signatures from the C2_DETECTRON_MODELS catalog', 'review_DATASET_CATALOG': 'review the DatasetCatalog class and its DATASETS dictionary to understand supported dataset paths and splits'}
```
